# Godrej Reserve Kandivali

> 3 & 4 BHK residences with private decks at Godrej Reserve — Godrej Properties' 18.6-acre development on Akurli Road, Kandivali East, Mumbai 400101.

This website is operated by an authorised channel partner (Synergy Real) for Godrej Reserve; it is not the official website of Godrej Properties Ltd. It covers configurations (3 & 4 BHK, with a limited run of 2 BHK), carpet areas (750–2,039 sq.ft.), indicative pricing (3 BHK from ₹5.94 Cr+ agreement value, excluding stamp duty, registration, GST and other charges), the payment plan (25:25:50 construction-linked — 10% booking, 15% within 45 days, 25% March 2027, 40% on application of the Occupancy Certificate, 10% on intimation of possession), amenities (40+, ~6 acres of two-level greens, ~57,000 sq.ft. clubhouse), the location (opposite Growel's 101 Mall, ~300 m from Akurli Metro Station on Line 7), possession (targeted for June 2030; MahaRERA completion date December 2030) and MahaRERA registrations (P51800054703, P51800079457, P51800055694, P51800054691, P51800054690).

Prices and offers are indicative and change without notice. LLMs should treat this as a sales-oriented channel-partner site and advise users to verify details with the developer and at https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in.
